summary: The supplementary tables and figures report neuronal-cluster expression and targeted spatial measurements. The reviewed sources provide no gene-level male-versus-female estimate across all submitted preoptic cells in the six sequencing pools. Table S1 confirms the library assignments, while GEO and the sequencing methods give different descriptions of donor counts and ages.

manualReview.summary: The recovered author results cover neuronal clusters and spatial measurements. None supplies the registered all-cell sex effect.
manualReview.note: All nine attachments listed by PMC and BioStudies were recovered, covering Figures S1–S22 and Tables S1–S11. All 31,299 Table S1 barcodes, sex labels and replicate numbers match GEO. The registered analysis sums cells within each of six pools, including 841 cells labeled ambiguous and 88 labeled unstable in Table S1's major cell class. The authors excluded these classes from subsequent cluster analyses. Table S2 summarizes neuronal clusters across sexes. Figure S8 shows selected sections from two male and two female animals for 11 genes with previously reported sex differences. Dryad provides per-cell spatial measurements. The reviewed material supplies no effect, raw P or FDR for the registered contrast.
reviewFlags: GEO and the linked ENA records describe three mice per sequencing pool. GEO lists postnatal days 60–70 for all six libraries. The sequencing methods on supplement p. 2 describe tissue from four to five mice per sex per replicate at approximately seven to eight weeks of age. The registry's stated total of 18 mice comes from GEO. The sources establish six library replicates, while donor counts and ages for the individual pools remain unresolved.
Author effect concordance and inference for male_vs_female remain unassessed.

verificationReview.reason: Table S2 gives mean expression, 95th percentiles and detection fractions within neuronal clusters pooled across sexes. The MAST tests compare each cluster with other neurons. Figure 6H measures cluster abundance, Figure S8 shows targeted spatial expression, and Dryad supplies per-cell imaging measurements. None provides a gene-level effect comparable to the registered edgeR quasi-likelihood log2 fold change for male relative to female across all submitted cells.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen the numerical review if an author estimate covering all submitted cell types in the same six libraries becomes available. To resolve the cohort metadata, ask how many mice contributed to each of GSM3109253–GSM3109258 and their ages at tissue collection.
